criticalRegions.meaning: Two-line model disclosure, separate from captions.
Foreground body, corrective shoes and deck contact.

frames.explanation: A substantial foreground walker leans and widens a step on a laterally displaced deck. Receding rails and riverbanks establish a physical place immediately.
frames.title: The bridge moves. The body responds.

criticalRegions.meaning: Two-line model disclosure, separate from captions.
Shaded posture, lateral corrective foot and contact pulse.

frames.explanation: Closer body-to-foot framing makes the corrective lateral placement legible. A small warm contact pulse sits on the deck, with a faint previous-position shoe witness.
frames.title: Balance becomes a lateral step.

criticalRegions.meaning: Two-line model disclosure, separate from captions.
Varied crowd, staggered contacts and bounded structural response.

frames.explanation: Varied body sizes and gait phases recede into the same bridge. Staggered contact pulses and bounded edge-position witnesses indicate collective response without unanimous marching.
frames.title: Many corrections. One moving structure.

criticalRegions.meaning: Two-line model disclosure, separate from captions.
Local pair within varied surrounding phases and active lateral response.

frames.explanation: An oblique bridge remains active. One small local pair has closer phases while the surrounding walkers differ; this is an illustrative possibility, not reconstructed opening-day evidence.
frames.title: Coordination can change the response.

criticalRegions.meaning: Two-line model disclosure, separate from captions.
Integrated bracing/dampers, walkers and residual response witnesses.

frames.explanation: The same bridge vocabulary shifts to an underside-aware oblique view. Integrated viscous-damper abstractions connect deck and bracing; warm dissipative accents and tight, nonzero position witnesses suggest controlled response.
frames.title: The structure sheds energy.

thesis: More physical, more cinematic, more human; one believable structural world with filled pedestrians, depth, contact-driven causality and restrained mechanism traces.
